panels.title: Stations reporting (last hour)
panels.description: Published stations with at least one reading in the last hour, out of all published stations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last.date_created > now() - interval '1 hour') AS "Reporting",
       COUNT(*) AS "Published"
FROM weather_stations s
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.date_created FROM weather_data d
    WHERE d.weather_station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY d.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
) last ON true
WHERE s.status = 'published' AND t.status <> 'inactive'

panels.title: Silent for over 2 hours
panels.description: Published stations with no reading for more than 2 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Silent > 2 h"
FROM weather_stations s
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.date_created FROM weather_data d
    WHERE d.weather_station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY d.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
) last ON true
WHERE s.status = 'published' AND t.status <> 'inactive'
  AND (last.date_created IS NULL OR last.date_created < now() - interval '2 hours')

panels.title: Frozen stations
panels.description: Stations whose last 6 readings (3 hours) are identical.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Frozen" FROM (
SELECT s.id
FROM weather_stations s
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.date_created, d.temperature, d.humidity, d.barometer, d.windspd, d.winddir
    FROM weather_data d
    WHERE d.weather_station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY d.date_created DESC LIMIT 6
) r
WHERE s.status = 'published' AND t.status <> 'inactive'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, t.label
HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
   AND MAX(r.date_created) > now() - interval '3 hours'
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT (r.temperature, r.humidity, r.barometer, r.windspd, r.winddir)) = 1
) frozen

panels.title: Empty pressure / humidity (24 h)
panels.description: Readings in the last 24 hours where pressure or humidity was cleared as impossible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Readings with empty pressure or humidity"
FROM weather_data d
WHERE d.date_created > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND (d.barometer IS NULL OR d.humidity IS NULL)

panels.title: Readings per hour, by station type
panels.description: Expected: 2 readings per hour per station. A type dropping to zero is an outage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(d.date_created, '1h'), t.label AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM weather_data d
JOIN weather_stations s ON s.id = d.weather_station_id
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.date_created)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last reading per station
panels.description: Minutes since each published station last reported. Orange after 1 hour, red after 2.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.id AS "ID", s.name AS "Station", t.label AS "Type",
       last.date_created AS "Last reading",
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last.date_created) / 60) AS "Minutes ago"
FROM weather_stations s
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.date_created FROM weather_data d
    WHERE d.weather_station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY d.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
) last ON true
WHERE s.status = 'published' AND t.status <> 'inactive'
ORDER BY "Minutes ago" DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Frozen stations (details)
panels.description: Stations whose last 6 readings are identical on temperature, humidity, pressure and wind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.id AS "ID", s.name AS "Station", t.label AS "Type",
       MAX(r.temperature) AS "Temperature", MAX(r.humidity) AS "Humidity",
       MAX(r.barometer) AS "Pressure", MAX(r.date_created) AS "Last reading"
FROM weather_stations s
JOIN weather_station_types t ON t.id = s.station_type
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.date_created, d.temperature, d.humidity, d.barometer, d.windspd, d.winddir
    FROM weather_data d
    WHERE d.weather_station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY d.date_created DESC LIMIT 6
) r
WHERE s.status = 'published' AND t.status <> 'inactive'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, t.label
HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
   AND MAX(r.date_created) > now() - interval '3 hours'
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT (r.temperature, r.humidity, r.barometer, r.windspd, r.winddir)) = 1
ORDER BY s.id

panels.title: Empty pressure / humidity (last 24 h)
panels.description: Stations whose pressure or humidity was cleared because it was outside the valid range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.id AS "ID", s.name AS "Station",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.barometer IS NULL) AS "Empty pressure",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.humidity IS NULL) AS "Empty humidity",
       COUNT(*) AS "Readings"
FROM weather_data d
JOIN weather_stations s ON s.id = d.weather_station_id
WHERE d.date_created > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.barometer IS NULL OR d.humidity IS NULL) > 0
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC
